title: Share of children enrolled in lower secondary school
subtitle: Comparing [net](#dod:net-enrollment-ratio) and [gross enrollment ratios](#dod:gross-enrolment-ratio) for children in [lower secondary](#dod:lower-secondary-education) education. Net enrollment shows the share of children of lower secondary school age (between 11 and 14 years old) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all children regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of the population of the same age group.
